comments.body:
[P2] [General] Instrument the structured Responses overloads

Supported SDK 2.20.1 also accepts `StructuredResponseCreateParams<T>` in `create` and `createStreaming`. Those calls fail this parameter-type check and fall through to `method.invoke(delegate, args)`. The SDK default methods then invoke the raw-params overload on the delegate, not on this proxy, so structured-output requests emit neither GenAI spans nor operation/token metrics. The async service has the same gap. A runtime probe against this head produced one span for each raw control call but zero for structured calls in both sync/async and streaming/non-streaming modes. Route the structured overloads through the traced raw-params paths while retaining SDK 1.1 compatibility, and cover them with a supported newer SDK.

[P2] [General] Keep derived Responses services instrumented

In supported SDK 2.20.1, `ResponseService.withOptions(...)` returns a new `ResponseServiceImpl`. Forwarding it here returns that unwrapped service, so normal usage such as `client.responses().withOptions(options -> options.timeout(...)).create(params)` silently loses all GenAI telemetry. `ResponseServiceAsync.withOptions(...)` has the same behavior. A runtime probe confirmed zero spans after deriving either service, versus one span for the corresponding direct call. Handle `withOptions` by wrapping the returned service with the same instrumenter, and cover calls through the derived sync and async services.
